summary: A square button with only an icon, for frequent, recognizable actions in toolbars, table rows and headers. Its label is still required: it becomes the accessible name.
whenToUse: Repeated row actions in tables and lists: edit, copy, delete, more.
Toolbars where space is tight and the icons are widely understood (close, copy, search, settings).
Opening a Menu of secondary actions (the more icon).
whenNotToUse: The primary action of a view: give it a text Button.
Any icon whose meaning is not obvious without its label: use a Button with iconStart instead.
Navigation to another page: use a Link.

dos.title: Name the action, not the picture
dos.text: label="Delete token" is what a screen reader says. "Trash" describes the drawing, not what happens.

dos.title: Pair with a Tooltip showing the same label
dos.text: Sighted mouse users get the name on hover; keyboard users get it on focus.

donts.title: A row of filled icon buttons
donts.text: Primary icon buttons in every row shout. Keep row actions ghost.

accessibility: label is required and becomes aria-label. The icon itself is aria-hidden.
Same keyboard behavior and focus ring as Button. Loading keeps focus and sets aria-busy.
The square target matches the control height (32/40/48 comfortable), never smaller than 24px.
contentGuidelines: Labels are verb plus object in sentence case: "Copy token name", "Close dialog".
Use the same label in the Tooltip so what users see and hear match.
